title: Bind immutable incumbent bytecode residue without trusting it

incident_reproduction_analysis.cause: The clean 6607b6a7 candidate reached an older ignored-bytecode residue (.orchestrator/__pycache__/) in live incumbent PID 2272245 running at dev ancestor 5877b644. build_candidate_runtime_identity on the incumbent root raised ValueError('Forbidden ignored directory found in candidate root: .orchestrator/__pycache__/'), correctly aborting promotion before mutation.
incident_reproduction_analysis.repair: Added a capture-only legacy boundary for incumbent bytecode residue (LegacyIncumbentBytecodeResidue and LegacyIncumbentBytecodeDirectoryResidue) with descriptor metadata, directory device/inode/mode binding, S_ISREG, st_nlink==1, CPython tag matching sys.implementation.cache_tag, MAGIC_NUMBER header verification, tracked .py source relation, and SHA256 digest binding. Candidate root cleanliness remains 100% deny-by-default. Rollback for incumbents carrying bytecode residue is materialized as a clean, immutable checkout at head_commit/tracked_tree; live incumbent root is never relaunched from or mutated.

safety_and_coherence_invariants.candidate_cleanliness: candidate_root cleanliness remains 100% deny-by-default (zero __pycache__, pyc, pyo, or arbitrary prefix allowlisting).
safety_and_coherence_invariants.bytecode_provenance: Admitted incumbent bytecode residue is strictly bound to PID/starttime/cwd/commit/tree/remote/config/environment, descriptor, S_ISREG, st_nlink==1, CPython tag/magic, tracked .py source relation, SHA256 digest, directory device/inode/mode identity, and revalidation. Hard links, symlinks, pyo, source-less pyc, foreign-tag pyc, unknown directories, directory substitution, and post-capture races are fail-closed.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.clean_rollback_materialization: Rollback launch root uses a separately materialized 100% clean immutable checkout proving zero __pycache__, pyc, or pyo. Live incumbent root is never reset, cleaned, stashed, checked out, edited, renamed, or copied as rollback source.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.launch_identity: Launch source contracts, config CAS, process signalling, -B / PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, 3 fresh loops, and rollback cleanup remain preserved.

no_live_rollout_boundary: This task is source-only. No live config edits, direct process signals, live runtime promotions, candidate deletions, canonical state edits, or fleet scheduling changes were performed.
